ci_support_linux_64_channel_sourcesconda:
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '15'
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge,conda-forge/label/python_rc
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
cxx_compiler:
- gxx
cxx_compiler_version:
- '15'
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.15.* *_cp315
target_platform:
- linux-64
zip_keys:
- - c_compiler_version
  - cxx_compiler_version
- - python
  - channel_sources
name: rapidfuzz
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: rapidfuzz
  version: "3.14.6"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: e13a8160d017b499ec7a2fa9d0ce1ae2e7377080815785819f966fb235d4eb60

build:
  number: 3
  script:
    - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vvv

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: python
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - cmake
    - if: not win
      then: make
    - if: win
      then: ninja
  host:
    - pip
    - python
    - scikit-build-core >=0.11
    - wheel
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python
    - numpy

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - rapidfuzz
      pip_check: true

about:
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: rapid fuzzy string matching
  homepage: https://github.com/maxbachmann/RapidFuzz
  repository: https://github.com/maxbachmann/RapidFuzz
  documentation: https://maxbachmann.github.io/RapidFuzz/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - xylar
    - maxbachmann
